The 3 extra are compiler-generated matchers (notchedCausality_dual_separates_hasChronalNeighbour.match_1_1, notchedCausality_separates_hasChronalNeighbour.match_1_1, not_locallyCausallyOpenFuture_of_causallyArcConnected_bare.match_1_1), which are rightly skipped.
